description_en: Call the CreateSQLAccount operation to create a privileged or standard account for an ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 调用CreateSQLAccount接口为云数据库ClickHouse集群创建高权限账号或普通账号
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse create-sql-account --db-cluster-id cc-bp1p816075e210000 --account-name test --account-password Test1234 --account-type Super --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSQLAccount

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database account.

The name must be unique.

It must consist of lowercase letters, digits, or underscores (_).

It must start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or a digit.

It must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号的名称。
名称唯一。
由小写字母、数字或下划线组成。
以小写字母开头，并且以小写字母或数字结尾。
长度为2~64个字符
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The password for the database account.

It must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.

The following characters are special characters: !@#$%^&*()_+-=

It must be 8 to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号的密码。
由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意三种组成。
!@#$%^&*()_+-=为特殊字符。
长度为8~32个字符
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en:
The description of the database account.

It cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

It can be 0 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号的描述。
不能以http://或https://开头。
长度为0~256个字符
parameters.name: account_description

parameters.help_en:
The type of the database account. Valid values:

Super: a privileged account.

Normal: a standard account
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号的类型，取值说明：
Super：高权限账号。
Normal：普通账号
parameters.name: account_type
